author: Cleo Abram
description:
How quiet are the world’s quietest rooms really? I’m in one right now!

Normal human conversation is around 60dB… The sound of your breathing is around 10…

The quietest sound humans can hear is roughly 0… But we know the sound of an AIR PARTICLE MOVING AROUND is about -23… 

This room is… drumroll please…. 

Subscribe for more!

#shorts #science #sciencefacts #sound #stemeducation
title: How Quiet Are the World’s Quietest Rooms?
